- It isolates a single design choice (aggregation method)
- Transformer aggregation could potentially capture more complex relationships between profiles
- If it improves, we have a new best; if not, we confirm avgpool is sufficient and can move to other dimensions

Alternatively, config_025 (weighted fusion with avgpool) would test whether the fusion method matters. But I think aggregation is the more impactful dimension to explore first since multiprofile was the biggest gain.

Let me go with config_026.
